note: Tier 2. Hill Giant (3/3) attacks and is blocked by two Grizzly Bears (2/2); A divides the Giant's 3 combat damage between the blockers as A chooses (510.1c), 2 and 1. The pinned 510.1c has no damage assignment order and no lethal-damage-first requirement: any division of the full 3 among the blockers is legal (its example lists every split of 4 between two blockers). Damage is dealt simultaneously (510.2); the Giant and the first Bears die (704.5g), the second Bears survives with 1 damage, blocking nothing. The record starts at the declare attackers step, A's declaration pending: an entry must answer the pending question (spec 4), and declare_attackers does not answer the priority of the precombat main phase, so the position is the boundary of the first decision (spec 2.4); A and B passed in the main phase and the beginning of combat step before it. Nothing is summoning sick: the Giant has been A's since before this turn (302.6). Every permanent is controlled by its owner and shows its printed values, so the start states no object facts.
